repo.description:
## Impact

When an OpenBao operator uses External Account Bindings (EAB) with Automatic Certificate Management Environment (ACME - RFC 8555) for certificate acquisition on TLS-enabled listeners, the sensitive `tls_acme_eab_mac_key` value was disclosed to callers of the `sys/config/state/sanitized` endpoint.

## Patch

This vulnerability is patched in OpenBao v2.7.1 and v2.6.4.
repo.summary: OpenBao's Sanitized Configuration Discloses ACME EAB MAC Key
